source_analysis_after_trial.format_mapping: PixelFormat::BC1_RGBA_SRGB is ordinal 64 in PIXEL_FORMAT_LIST at pinned base commit. Flags decode from ImageFlagBits.
source_analysis_after_trial.conversion_cause: D3D12 decodes BC 2D arrays by default to avoid documented Xbox array texture sampling/copy disagreement. BC1 sRGB becomes RGBA8 sRGB, approximately 8x expansion.
source_analysis_after_trial.existing_override: bc_arrays=native exists but was not enabled: using it on PC would bypass the Xbox workaround and is not a validated console fix.
source_analysis_after_trial.next_target: Avoid whole expanded-array staging, preserving correct decoded representation and original compressed blocks. Chunking without submission/reuse bounds can still accumulate the same staging bytes.
source_analysis_after_trial.separate_failure: Run 1 failed allocating final GPU texture; removing expanded staging alone does not prove that failure is fixed.
